children: Equinor said it has discovered gas at the North Sea's Gullfaks South field along with its partners.

The Norwegian energy company said Thursday that between 500,000 and 1.6 million standard cubic meters of recoverable oil equivalents have been discovered, corresponding to between 3.3 million and 10.3 million barrels of oil equivalent.
"These will be profitable barrels that can help maintain activity and production on the Gullfaks field," said Gunnar Egge, Equinor's vice president for the Gullfaks field.
The discovery is within the production license for Gullfaks, which is owned by Equinor, Petoro and OMV.
